verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch documents retrieval APIs suited to RAG: semantic_text auto-embedding, vector search, single-request hybrid search with RRF, and reranking. Its docs explicitly name RAG and question-answering systems as target use cases, and release notes mention OpenAI chat completion passthrough. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end conversational answer or generation API with usage detail, a RAG-specific guide in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
